placement: first eligible delivery-stop arrival or service end on trip 1, else trip 2; no new route waiting or intertrip break
location_policy: explicit verified-only or assumed-existing-stop mode, shared by all methods and included in input fingerprint
post_final_depot_break: active vehicles only; final return <=12:00; break fixed at 12:00-13:00; no work during break
unused_vehicles: exclude from driver break constraints and record explicitly
